summary.one_liner: A step-by-step book/guide that teaches building a blockchain from scratch in Ruby, starting with crypto hashes, and published as a live web version.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a tutorial book that builds blockchains from zero, beginning with cryptographic hashes. Its listed chapters cover blocks and blocks with proof-of-work, chaining blocks into a blockchain and detecting when the chain is broken, timestamping, mining, and Bitcoin. The README says the book is "to be continued" and includes a references/links section. The live version is hosted on GitHub Pages at yukimotopress.github.io/programming-blockchains-step-by-step. The README does not show any code or describe the exact runnable project structure.
use_cases: learn how blockchains work by building one
read a free public domain blockchain tutorial
notable: Written as a step-by-step book that builds a blockchain from zero
